name: MSc Project/Internship
description: This course encompasses the major dissertation work for the MSc biological sciences program undertaken in the third semester. The work may include the following semester-long project work activity based on pre-approved and clear objectives to solve a research problem in the frontier areas of biological sciences. The students can opt between (i) A project work under the supervision of a faculty at IIT Delhi, (ii) A project work in any other research institute or academic institution in India or abroad preapproved by the school research committee (ScRC) and with a KSBS co-supervisor/mentor (iii) an industrial internship on a research problem and external mentor preapproved by the ScRC with a KSBS co-supervisor/mentor. Project evaluation to be performed by a committee including the project mentor(s)/supervisor(s), MSc program coordinator and ScRC nominee(s).
